note: A pitch that lands. Numbers early, holds the point through the interrupt, gets a real next step.

call.summary: Founder pitched a freight invoice reconciliation tool. Answered both objections with figures and secured a follow-up conditional on sending customer data.
evidence: Trainee stated 40,000 dollars a month in overbilling against 4.5 million in freight spend.
Trainee gave a per-invoice cost of 11 cents today and 4 cents at 10x.
Persona agreed to a second call next week if the data holds.

objections_raised: Why does this need to exist? What breaks if it doesn't?
What does one unit cost you today, and at 10x?
structuredResult.strongest_moment: Giving the 40,000 a month figure from customer data before being asked twice.
structuredResult.weakest_moment: Took a beat to connect the recovery figure to total spend.

transcriptTurns.speaker: bot
transcriptTurns.text: Heads up, this is a simulated practice persona, not a real person. Right, you have got five minutes. Go.

transcriptTurns.speaker: user
transcriptTurns.text: Thanks. We are building a reconciliation layer for freight invoices. Carriers overbill on about nine percent of shipments and nobody catches it because the audit is manual.

transcriptTurns.speaker: bot
transcriptTurns.text: Why does this need to exist? What breaks if it doesn't?

transcriptTurns.speaker: user
transcriptTurns.text: Without it a mid-size shipper writes off roughly forty thousand dollars a month in overbilling. That is the number our first three customers found in their own data before they paid us anything.

transcriptTurns.speaker: user
transcriptTurns.text: Against about four and a half million a month in freight. So just under one percent recovered, and the audit team drops from four people to one.

transcriptTurns.speaker: bot
transcriptTurns.text: What does one unit cost you today, and at 10x?

transcriptTurns.speaker: user
transcriptTurns.text: An invoice costs us eleven cents to process today, mostly model inference. At ten times the volume it is four cents, because the batches get better and we stop paying per-call pricing.

transcriptTurns.speaker: user
transcriptTurns.text: Two million, eighteen months of runway, and the milestone is fifty shippers live and a million dollars in recovered spend.

transcriptTurns.speaker: bot
transcriptTurns.text: Fine. Send me the customer data on those three, the real files, not a summary. If the nine percent holds I will take a second call next week.

transcriptTurns.speaker: user
transcriptTurns.text: I will have it to you today. Thanks for the time.
